tools.name: base_gas

tools.name: base_block

tools.name: token_price

tools.name: dex_pair

tools.name: base_tx

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: chainlink_staleness, chainlink_feeds · Private data: token_price, token_info, wallet_snapshot, dex_pair, token_pairs, token_liquidity, token_volume, token_price_change, token_txns, token_fdv, token_balance, token_supply, token_links, token_allowance, token_search, token_price_eth, dex_search, dex_pair_lookup, dex_trending, dex_latest_boosts, dex_new_profiles, dex_pairs_count, uniswap_v3_pool, yields_token, ens_records, wallet_eth_value, wallet_known_holdings · Public sink: stablecoin_dominance.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: chainlink_staleness, chainlink_feeds · Private data: token_price, token_info, wallet_snapshot, dex_pair, token_pairs, token_liquidity, token_volume, token_price_change, token_txns, token_fdv, token_balance, token_supply, token_links, token_allowance, token_search, token_price_eth, dex_search, dex_pair_lookup, dex_trending, dex_latest_boosts, dex_new_profiles, dex_pairs_count, uniswap_v3_pool, yields_token, ens_records, wallet_eth_value, wallet_known_holdings · Public sink: stablecoin_dominance

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.

remediation.title: Tool description changed since last scan
remediation.detail: Tool "dex_search" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.
